definitions.explanation: Something or someone different from what has been mentioned; alternatives.

examples.japanese: {他|ほか}に{質問|しつもん}はありますか。
{他|ほか}の{人|ひと}に{聞|き}いてみよう。
この{店|みせ}の{他|ほか}にもいくつかあります。
examples.english: There are several others besides this store.

notes:
KANJI VARIATIONS:
・{他|ほか} - other (abstract, general)
・{外|ほか} - outside, other (physical sense)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{他|ほか}に (in addition, besides)
・{他|ほか}の〜 (other ~, another ~)
・その{他|ほか} (and others, etc.)
・{他|ほか}ならぬ (none other than)

GRAMMAR:
・〜の{他|ほか}に (besides ~, in addition to ~)
・〜{他|ほか}ない (have no choice but to ~)

RELATED:
・{別|べつ}の - another, different
・{以外|いがい} - other than, except
